title: Shaded Beige Glass Shelf, 16-Inch Triple Tier Wall Mount, Solid Brass & Tempered Glass, Allied Brass
description: Glass shelf, 16 x 5 inches, triple tier wall mount vanity shelf with solid brass hardware and 3/8-in (0.38 in) thick tempered, beveled-edge glass for bathroom storage and organization — available in Shaded Beige, which offers sophisticated warmth in a soft, neutral tone that complements natural materials and earthy palettes. Contemporary, modern bathroom hardware for keeping toiletries, fragrance, and daily essentials within reach while saving counter space. Concealed screw mounting creates a clean, minimalist bathroom fixtures look; includes glass shelf and all installation hardware (uses #8 x 1 1/4" screws). Weight capacity 6 lb. Available in multiple designer finish options. Limited Lifetime Warranty. Allied Brass.
